generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Consortium (Limited to maximum of Two(2) constituents including Prime/Lead Bidder) are also acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The Tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall upload Bank Guarantee issued either by a Nationalized/Scheduled Bank /Insurance Surety Bond issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) towards balance EMD/ BID SECURITY(For the balance EMD above Rs. 1Lakh) (SCHEDULE-17) as detailed in Clause No. 13 of ITT) in the prescribed form, failing which the offer will be rejected. Also, the Bidder shall ensure that the Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond drawn in favour of CEE, T&P, KPTCL towards EMD shall be sent in original to the CEE, T&P, KPTCL, Bangalore so as to reach after the last date of submission of bid and on or before the date and time notified for opening of Techno-Commercial Bids in a sealed cover, failing which their bid will not be opened
Tenderer shall upload the legible documents only
Bidder shall not take any deviations on the clauses listed in the No Deviation Certificate(Annexure-I).

Please note that the filled in Techno Commercial sheet shall be uploaded along with all the other QR documents. Percentage above / below / equal to the amount put to tender shall be quoted in the Financial bid offer, provisioned in the e-procurement portal. In case the prices are uploaded in/ along the Techno commercial bid, then bid will be summarily rejected. The Techno- commercial shall be uploaded in KPTCL excel formats only

Bidder shall comply with all terms and conditions of the tender. Deviations, if any on the Commercial as well as Technical part shall be brought out clearly in the Schedule-5 and Schedule-6 of the Techno Commercial sheets, respectively
